name: Meta Membership – Mailing List
author: jerrystewart99

sections.description:
Meta Membership – Mailing List is a free add-on for Meta Membership
It enables you to automatically sync mailing lists to membership types and status and trigger mailing list send.

Key Features

  • Designed as an add-on for Meta Membership – requires the core plugin to function.
  • Supports integration with compatible email/mailing list services. Includes native support for MailPoet.

Perfect for:

  • Membership organisations
  • Clubs and societies
  • Event-driven communities
  • Training and workshop providers
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Meta Membership (required).
  2. Upload the meta-membership-mailing-list folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate Meta Membership – Mailing List from the Plugins screen.
  4. Configure List sync rules.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without Meta Membership?

No. Meta Membership – Mailing List is an add-on and requires Meta Membership to be installed and active.

Which email services does it support?

Currently tested with MailPoet. Additional integrations will be added over time.

short_description: An add-on to the Meta Membership plugin that keeps your membership status/membership type in sync with your mailing-list lists.
